title: hotfix: fix SLO enforcer race during regional failover causing dropped requests
author: Priya Raman
body: Context: During a recent regional failover exercise we observed the SLO enforcer enter a transient race where two concurrent failover handlers both attempted to open the circuit for the same customer shard. This resulted in duplicate backoff timers and a window where requests were neither retried nor shed, causing a small but measurable increase in user errors. Motivation: this is a production-impacting race that can occur when region-change events are processed concurrently (e.g., controller failover + operator-triggered plan). This hotfix ensures single-writer semantics for SLO state transitions and makes backoff timers idempotent. Changes: 1) introduce in-memory per-shard state lock with optimistic CAS to serialize state transitions; 2) make circuit-open and backoff timer registration idempotent (no-op if already registered); 3) add a short jitter to backoff windows to avoid synchronized reopening across replicas; 4) add extra metrics and tracing to surface state transition races. Testing & verification: unit tests for CAS path, integration test simulating concurrent failover handlers, and a canary rollout to a low-traffic region. Checklist: - [x] Reproduced race locally with test harness - [x] Added unit & integration tests - [x] Re-ran CI and verified green - [x] Canary deployed to eu-west-1 for 2h with no regressions - [x] Coordinated with ops for manual rollback plan Rollout/merge notes: squash-merged to main, immediate deploy to staging and progressive canary to eu-west-1 then us-west-2. Follow-up: audit metrics for 48h and consider persistent lease for long-lived controller reconciliations (ENG-8423).
commits: fix(slo-enforcer): serialize state transitions with CAS and idempotent timer registration
test(slo-enforcer): add concurrent failover integration test
docs: add notes about backoff jitter and metrics
review_comments: Jordan Li: Nice isolation of the CAS path; one comment about error handling if the state store is temporarily unavailable.
Priya Raman: addressed the error handling in state_store.go, added retry with bounded backoff and explicit instrumented metric (slo_enforcer_state_store_retries_total).
Camille Ortega: CI flake on the integration test initially (timeout). Increased timeout and added deterministic synchronization; tests now stable.
Diego Fernández: Approved after verifying canary dashboards and end-to-end traces - good to merge.
release_notes: Hotfix: Fix race in SLO enforcer during regional failover that could drop requests. Adds serialization for state transitions, idempotent backoff registration, jitter to backoff windows, and additional metrics/tracing.
